text: I do believe two people can choose sexual exclusivity without pretending. They can admit that attraction to other people exists and decide not to act on it each day. And even better than simply suppressing it, they can put it to work. I agree with Esther Perel, who writes that this sexual energy felt outside the relationship can be used and redirected into the relationship to make it more alive.
reader: someone reading an essay on romance for advice they can use in their own dating and relationships
